items.name: page/page-transition
items.title: Page Transition
items.description: PageTransition and navigateWithTransition: route changes animated by React's <ViewTransition>.

items.name: page/fade
items.title: Fade
items.description: The old page fades out as the new one fades in.

items.name: page/slide
items.title: Slide
items.description: Pages slide past each other; backward navigations reverse.

items.name: page/scale
items.title: Scale
items.description: The new page scales up while the old one fades out.

items.name: page/flip
items.title: Flip
items.description: A 3D card flip around the vertical axis.

items.name: page/blur
items.title: Blur
items.description: The old page blurs away while the new one sharpens in.

items.name: page/rotate
items.title: Rotate
items.description: The new page rotates in while the old one fades out.

items.name: page/zoom
items.title: Zoom
items.description: The old page zooms out as the new one zooms in.

items.name: page/curtain
items.title: Curtain
items.description: The new page opens out of a centre strip as the old one closes into it.

items.name: page/cube
items.title: Cube
items.description: Pages turn around the faces of a 3D cube.

items.name: page/skew-slide
items.title: Skew Slide
items.description: Pages skew as they slide past each other.

items.name: page/page-curl
items.title: Page Curl
items.description: The old page curls up from the corner like a book page.

items.name: page/accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: The old page folds shut towards one edge as the new one unfolds from it.

items.name: page/doorway
items.title: Doorway
items.description: The old page swings away on a hinge, revealing the new one.

items.name: page/book-flip
items.title: Book Flip
items.description: The new page turns over the old one around a central spine.

items.name: page/roll
items.title: Roll
items.description: The old page rolls away like a scroll as the new one unrolls.

items.name: page/fold
items.title: Fold
items.description: The old page folds inward along its centre as the new one emerges.

items.name: page/glitch
items.title: Glitch
items.description: The old page jitters out in stepped frames before the new one snaps in.

::view-transition-old(.tk-page-glitch).animation: tk-page-glitch-out var(--tk-page-duration, 400ms) var(--tk-page-easing, steps(6, end)) both

::view-transition-new(.tk-page-glitch).animation: tk-page-glitch-in var(--tk-page-duration, 400ms) var(--tk-page-easing, steps(6, end)) both

items.name: page/iris-wipe
items.title: Iris Wipe
items.description: An iris closes on the old page and opens on the new one.

::view-transition-new(.tk-page-iris-wipe.animation: tk-page-iris-wipe-open calc(var(--tk-page-duration, 700ms) / 2) var(--tk-page-easing, ease-out) calc(var(--tk-page-duration, 700ms) / 2) both

items.name: ui/ui-transition
items.title: UI Transition
items.description: The tk() class helper, useTransitionNames and the tk-* View Transition Classes every UI component composes with React's <ViewTransition>.

::view-transition-new(.tk-fade):only-chi.animation: var(--tk-ui-enter) var(--tk-ui-ease-out) calc(var(--tk-ui-delay, 0s) + var(--tk-ui-exit) / 2) both tk-fade-in

items.name: ui/tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: The active pill glides to the selected tab and the panel slides in the direction you moved.

items.name: ui/segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: An iOS-style segmented control whose thumb glides to the chosen option with a slight spring.

items.name: ui/accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Opening a panel grows its item and the items below glide down, with no height measured in JavaScript.

items.name: ui/carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Slides push in like a track from the side you moved toward, with arrows, dots, swipe, keyboard and optional autoplay.

items.name: ui/stack-navigator
items.title: Stack Navigator
items.description: iOS-style push and pop screens in a fixed frame. Screens slide in the direction you travel and the title glides into the back button.

items.name: ui/step-wizard
items.title: Step Wizard
items.description: A multi-step form whose panels slide in the direction you move and whose progress indicator glides between steps.

items.name: ui/dynamic-island
items.title: Dynamic Island
items.description: A pill that springs between sizes as its state changes, with the content blurring across inside it.

items.name: ui/status-button
items.title: Status Button
items.description: A button that morphs from idle to loading to success or error, resizing smoothly while its label and icon crossfade.

items.name: ui/number-flip
items.title: Number Flip
items.description: Changed digits roll up when the number grows and down when it shrinks. Separators and unchanged digits stay put.

items.name: ui/add-to-cart
items.title: Add to Cart
items.description: The product image flies into the cart button, the badge count rolls up and the button label morphs to "Added".

items.name: ui/morphing-popover
items.title: Morphing Popover
items.description: A trigger that morphs into its popover surface and back.

items.name: ui/product-gallery
items.title: Product Gallery
items.description: A hero image with a thumbnail strip. The chosen thumbnail grows into the hero while the old hero shrinks back into its slot.

items.name: ui/layout-switcher
items.title: Layout Switcher
items.description: Toggle a collection between grid and list. Every card, avatar, name and stat glides to its new spot.

items.name: ui/animated-list
items.title: Animated List
items.description: A list whose items pop in, fade out and glide into place as they change.

items.name: ui/filter-grid
items.title: Filter Grid
items.description: Filter a grid with chips and search. Matches reflow into place, the rest pop out, and new items pop in one after another.

items.name: ui/sortable-table
items.title: Sortable Table
items.description: Click a column header to sort and the rows glide to their new positions. Filtered rows fade out while the rest close the gap.

items.name: ui/kanban-board
items.title: Kanban Board
items.description: Drag cards between columns, or move them with the keyboard. The card glides into place, its neighbours make room and the column counts roll.
